rooms.name: Pantry
rooms.desc: A pantry with two wine barrels against the east wall.

rooms.name: Servants' Quarters
rooms.desc: Four simple beds and four plain trunks.
rooms.dm: Two beds belong to the missing butler and lady-in-waiting.

rooms.name: Den
rooms.desc: A den that reeks of pipe smoke; a bear's head glowers from the east wall.
rooms.dm: The bear was a gift from the elder Szoldar, not the baron's father's kill.

rooms.name: Entrance Hall and Vestibule
rooms.desc: A grand foyer: portraits, a wide stair with a sculpted rail, twigs heaped for the festival, a cloakroom in the corner.
rooms.dm: A maid answers; she brings callers to the den and fetches the baron.

rooms.name: Long Hall
rooms.desc: A long carpeted hall with doors on both sides.

rooms.name: Kitchen
rooms.desc: A kitchen with a stair in the corner and a door to the garden.
rooms.dm: The garden door is locked; the cook and the baron have keys.

rooms.name: Preparation Room
rooms.desc: Two sheeted tables: polished silver on one, baskets of turnips and beets on the other.

rooms.name: Dining Room
rooms.desc: A chandelier of wrought iron over a polished table; eight women at tea and cake while a ninth talks of decorations.
rooms.dm: Lydia Petrovna bribing peasant women with tea. She sends them to the den and calls the baron.

rooms.name: Parlor
rooms.desc: A parlor of couches and a low table by a bookcase.

rooms.name: Porch
rooms.desc: The mansion's porch and double doors, festival banners on the posts.

objects.label: A vestibule packed with fine cloaks, coats and boots
Framed portraits of past burgomasters
Bundles of twigs pile up here for the wicker sun of the festival. A maid answers the door and leads callers to the den.
A brown bear's head mounted on the east wall (a Grygorovich gift, whatever the baron says)
Two beds are the butler's and the lady-in-waiting's: both missing (see the attic).
The cook (commoner); carries the garden-door key
A complete set of polished silverware laid out under a sheet
Wicker baskets of turnips and beets
Baroness Lydia Petrovna and eight peasant women at tea

rooms.name: Master Bedroom
rooms.desc: A faded master bedroom; a pull-rope hangs from a trapdoor in the ceiling.
rooms.dm: The folding ladder leads to the attic room.

rooms.name: Master Bedroom Closet
rooms.desc: A closet of fine clothes.

rooms.name: Bathroom
rooms.desc: An iron tub with clawed feet; folded towels on a table.

rooms.name: Library
rooms.desc: A windowless library, shelves floor to ceiling, more books than any house in Barovia should hold.
rooms.dm: The baron sits here in breastplate and rapier, paranoid. Random books as in the castle study.

rooms.name: Victor's Bedroom
rooms.desc: A handsome room: a canopied bed, a low bookshelf, a full-length mirror, an arched window to the north.

rooms.name: Izek's Bedroom
rooms.desc: A bed and a heavy chest piled with dolls, every one with the same auburn hair.
rooms.dm: Izek's room, locked. The dolls are Ireena. A shortsword in the chest; empty bottles under the bed.

rooms.name: Bridal Gown and Spirit Mirror
rooms.desc: A bridal gown on a stand and a tall mirror; a door in the corner to a garderobe.
rooms.dm: The spirit mirror: the rhyme summons the Ba'al Verzi assassin's ghost, who charms and leads to the roof.

rooms.name: Locked Closet
rooms.desc: A bare closet with manacles on the wall.
rooms.dm: Udo Lukovich, chained for complaining; the baron holds the keys.

rooms.name: Upstairs Gallery
rooms.desc: A gallery twenty feet above the foyer, landscapes on the walls, red drapes over a tall arched window; narrow halls lead north.

rooms.name: Gallery (north passage)
rooms.desc: A narrow hall between the library and the bedrooms.

objects.label: Framed landscapes along the gallery; red silk drapes over a tall arched window
A pull-rope trapdoor in the ceiling: a folding ladder up to the attic room
Baron Vargas and Lydia sleep here at night
Baron Vargas Vallakovich in breastplate and rapier, ring and three keys
Windowless, lined floor to ceiling with books (random books table). Keys: the garden door, the closet door, the manacles.
A full-length mirror in a wooden frame across from the door
Dolls in Ireena's likeness everywhere: 'Is No Fun, Is No Blinsky!'
A shortsword under wrinkled clothes in the unlocked chest; empty bottles under the bed
Izek Strazni (when at home)
The spirit mirror: speak the rhyme within 5 ft and the Ba'al Verzi assassin's ghost appears
Lydia's bridal gown on a stand; a door in the corner to a garderobe.
Udo Lukovich, the shoemaker, manacled for malicious unhappiness

rooms.name: Attic Room
rooms.desc: A dusty room under a high peaked roof: an old table with a lantern.

rooms.name: Attic Storage
rooms.desc: Attic storage crammed with old furniture and crates under sheets.
rooms.dm: A single trail of footprints leads to the workroom.

rooms.name: Victor's Workroom
rooms.desc: A study of mismatched furniture, parchment diagrams on the tables, a shelf of bones, three small children standing with their backs to the door.
rooms.dm: Victor practises teleportation; the children are his failures. Six cat skeletons. The circle is deadly.

objects.label: Glyph of warding on the skull-carved door: 5d8 lightning for anyone but Victor
'ALL IS NOT WELL!' hangs from the knob; a young voice practises a teleport spell beyond.
The folding ladder down to the master bedroom
One set of footprints in the dust leads east to the workroom.
Victor Vallakovich (mage apprentice) at his flawed teleportation circle
Three "children" with their backs turned: the dead butler and lady-in-waiting (Victor's mistake) and a dummy
Six cat skeletons (cat stats, darkvision, poison immunity)
Victor's circle: DC 15 Arcana shows it is flawed and deadly to use
